title.en: Active Mobility (Enforcement Detection System Testing — Exemption) Order 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en:
1.—(1) This Order is the Active Mobility (Enforcement Detection System Testing — Exemption) Order 2024.
(2) This Order is in force for the period between 18 July 2024 and 30 September 2027 (both dates inclusive).

heading.en: Exemption for riding specified PAB on public paths
